scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @careflow360/api" "npm run dev -w @careflow360/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @careflow360/api && npm run build -w @careflow360/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @careflow360/api && npm run typecheck -w @careflow360/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @careflow360/api && npm run lint -w @careflow360/web
